answer: Run a Pulse Beacon Check, one agent to one device-bound key. First, the agent registers that key and posts a 5 POA bond. Second, each epoch the beacon posts a random value, and the agent must sign it within 10 minutes as proof of possession. Third, peers verify the signature, and trying to forge a second identity from that device loses the bond and bans the key. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 10,000 devices at $40 each ($400,000), 50,000 POA in bonds, and 30 days of signings. Like a lighthouse that answers only ships with the right lantern, it lets agents pass and leaves copies in the dark.
